nodes.label: Pessimistic Row Locking for Overselling Prevention
nodes.norm_label: pessimistic row locking for overselling prevention
nodes.rationale: Concurrency is controlled with lock:{mode:'pessimistic_write'} inside dataSource.transaction on the inventory/product row so concurrent reservation requests cannot oversell stock; availability is computed as stock-reserved_amount and never stored independently.

nodes.label: Modular Monolith Architecture Principle
nodes.rationale: Chosen to keep clear module boundaries and simple transactional consistency while allowing infrastructure (Redis, RabbitMQ) to scale independently later without becoming a distributed system; avoids premature microservices and permits later module extraction.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL as System of Record
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL 17 is the authoritative, strongly-consistent store for all transactional business state (users, products, cart, orders, inventory); accessed via TypeORM with UUIDv4 PKs, camelCase columns, and DB-level constraints to enforce invariants.

nodes.label: Redis Cache-Only (Not Authoritative)
nodes.rationale: Redis 8 is used only as a cache via @nestjs/cache-manager+@keyv/redis so fast reads (product listing) and future rate limiting/job storage are possible without coupling business correctness to a cache; inventory/reservation decisions must never rely on cached values and Redis may be unavailable without corrupting the domain.

nodes.label: RabbitMQ Post-Commit Async Events
nodes.rationale: RabbitMQ 4 is connected as a NestJS microservice for notifications published AFTER the DB transaction commits, so the broker stays infrastructure (not a source of truth) and never sits inside the inventory/order consistency-critical path.

nodes.label: JWT + Passport + bcrypt Auth
nodes.rationale: Stateless REST auth via Passport local strategy, JWT sessions, and bcrypt (salt rounds 10); role-based access through UserRoles enum, JwtGuard+RolesGuard and the @Auth decorator, with passwords never returned; centralized so controllers never hand-roll auth.

nodes.label: GraphQL for Products, REST Elsewhere
nodes.rationale: Products exposed via Apollo code-first GraphQL for a flexible query API while auth/cart/order remain REST with Swagger; the mixed surface is intentional and both share the same global AllExceptionsFilter and validation philosophy, with the transport-agnostic @Auth pattern reusable on GraphQL.

nodes.label: Inventory / Reservation Intended Model
nodes.rationale: Target design separates Inventory (stock, reserved_amount, available=stock-reserved_amount) from Product and adds Reservation(+ReservationItem) with expires_at and states RESERVED→COMPLETED|EXPIRED|CANCELLED; all reservation+inventory writes are transactional with pessimistic row locking and RabbitMQ events publish only after DB commit; intended but not yet implemented.

nodes.label: Inventory Entity (Target Design)
nodes.rationale: Planned Inventory entity separate from Product with product_id, stock, reserved_amount and DB constraints stock>=0, reserved_amount>=0, reserved_amount<=stock; InventoryService remains the only writer of stock/reserved_amount; available is derived not stored.

nodes.label: Reservation + ReservationItem Entities (Target)
nodes.rationale: Planned Reservation (user_id, order_id nullable, status, expires_at) and ReservationItem (reservation_id, inventory_id, quantity) to represent temporary claims on inventory records; one inventory record per product with a unique constraint.

nodes.label: Reservation Lifecycle State Machine
nodes.rationale: Explicit reservation state transitions RESERVED→COMPLETED|EXPIRED|CANCELLED with inventory effects (reserved_amount adjust on hold/release; stock decrement only on completion); invalid transitions must be rejected, and a cleanup worker expires RESERVED reservations where expires_at<=NOW() idempotently.

nodes.label: Spec-Driven Development Process
nodes.rationale: Feature work is driven via Spec Kit: Specification→Clarification→Design→Plan→Implement→Test→Verify; the specification is the source of truth and business rules must not be invented when undecided (raise as open questions); verify before declaring done.
